interactions.note: The epitope of A2C7 Fab on the A33 VAVC protein was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement. The A33/A2C7 complex shows two Fab molecules symmetrically bound to the A33 dimer. The asymmetric unit of the crystal contained half of the biological assembly (A2C7 Fab bound to one A33 monomer), which dimerized along a crystallographic symmetry axis.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.3 angstroms
The epitope-specific mAb A2C7 recognized recombinant  A33 VAVC protein, but did not react with overlapping 20-mer peptides spanning the sequence of A33.

interactions.assay: bio-layer interferometry assay · dissociation constant KD
interactions.note: The affinity of epitope-specific mAb A2C7 for binding to recombinant  A33 VAVC protein was determined by biolayer interferometry using an OctetRED instrument. The affinity with the antibody immobilized on the biosensor was similar to that when A33 was immobilized (KD = 0.114 nM). Binding studies were done using the A33 protein with three mutations, Leu118Met, Lys123Ala and Leu140Met, introduced to aid crystallization. The affinity for the A33 variant with only mutation Lys123Ala (KD = 0.188 nM) was similar. The binding results are consistent with size exclusion chromatography analysis which showed that one A2C7 Fab bound to one A33 subunit. A33 mutation Gln173Arg or Leu118Arg abolished binding of the antibody.

The affinity of epitope-specific mAb A27D7 for binding to recombinant A33 VAVC protein was determined by biolayer interferometry using an OctetRED instrument with the antibody immobilized on the biosensor. When A33 was immobilized, the apparent binding affinity increased to KD < 1 pM, due to very slow dissociation of A27D7 from A33. Binding studies were done using the A33 protein with three mutations, Leu118Met, Lys123Ala and Leu140Met, introduced to aid crystallization. The affinity for the A33 variant with only mutation Lys123Ala (KD < 1 pM) was similar. The binding results are consistent with size exclusion chromatography analysis which showed that one A27D7 Fab bound to one A33 dimer.; Unmapped quantitative response: on rate 1090000 M^-1s^-1
